question:
What is the value of the following expression?

103 - [144 ÷ (12 × 12) + 5 + 12 ÷ (6 - 2) + 10]
solution:
**Given:**

103 - [144 ÷ (12 × 12) + 5 + 12 ÷ (6 - 2) + 10]

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://lh6.googleusercontent.com/vUaBr3tL60KzuuO9oMfKO-Skgye0zl5jfd3laYfkuLhd_NG7bYa31x4-8pN3NqN2IMinwHRNuwUbQpLmm6FL2-yvs19LnIBzeVWcitqzx2GUb9ZMv8Tj5GzuRR_4uKTlmCvfRTlV3TKHzuTV] 

**Calculation:**

103 - [(144 ÷ (12 × 12)) + 5 + (12 ÷ (6 - 2)) + 10]

⇒ 103 - [(144 ÷ 144) + 5 + (12 ÷ 4) + 10]

⇒ 103 - [1 + 5 + 3 + 10]

⇒ 103 - 19 = 84

**∴ The value of the following expression is 84.**
